A mother bobcat went up the hill behind our house this morning about 6:30.  It was still pretty dark but I managed to get three usable pictures.

There was not much light and the cubs were moving so the quality is not great but it was a very cool scene.  Follow this link to flickr and then scroll  right using the > to the right of each picture to see the cubs.

https://www.flickr.com/photos/loualexander/48659002983/in/album-72157678605251754/

A young bobcat that I scared the dickens out of when I went out the backdoor to check on my fire in the Weber.  It was messing around in the leaves about 20 feet off the patio and raced down the hill when it saw me.  You can get an idea of its size from the fence behind it.

Bobcats are some of the most challenging animals in Nature to be able see, let alone get a photo of. Two reasons for this, they are mostly crepuscular to nocturnal (yet not exclusively) and they are silent as they move about cover. This Bobcat was zig-zagging around in a fast walk as he/she foraged in a half-circle around me while I was watching for some bear friends.

Early one morning this past year I got a surprise... a Bobcat hunting rodents on the edge of a mountain lake. Had to go with a location area, not specific for many reasons. Also have a video of this Bobcat hunting.
